expect_red: a block part whose other edges end on another block's pins is one run: one bracket in the grid and one block in the DAG

mutations.contract: A part's edges that are not its block's chords are gathered with it, so the part is one run.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff the_hub_is_one_part_in_the_grid_and_the_dag (2026-11-15). Only pins and chords are gathered, as before the fix: the hub's two dimensions to the mount stay at the foot of the body.
mutations.find: return blockPartOf(row, pins) || (row.kind === "edge" ? edgePart[row.id] || null : null);
